Package dev.px.core.math

Class Range

java.lang.Object
dev.px.core.math.Range
public final class Range extends Object
An immutable inclusive numeric interval.

Replaces BetweenInteger, which mutated itself to keep min below max and so could not be shared or compared safely. Construction normalises the bounds once and the value never changes afterwards.
